_comment: Max first-load JavaScript per route, transferred kB (gzip over the wire), 375 px mobile viewport, cold cache, production build (npm run build && npx next start -p 3140; node scripts/measure-bundles.mjs). Each value is the measured figure at the time of writing plus 10%. Lab bytes, not Core Web Vitals. Enforced by tests/site/perf-budget.test.ts against a live production server: by the `site` CI job on every pull request, and by hand with PERF_BASE_URL set. It is a ratchet: lower a number when a route gets lighter; raise one only by a deliberate, reviewed edit.
coverage_added_on: 2026-11-08 (13 routes added from a measurement plus 10%: /products/density-screen /constraints/busway-ampacity /for/ai-operators /lead-times /commissioned /platforms /observatory /observatory/presenter /legal/* /guides/nameplate-vs-useful-compute /account/sites)
